will-spacex-have-the-highest-ipo-market-.note: 0.96 -> 0.95 on 2026-08-12 via the recency sweep prompted by the MacBook staleness finding. The sweep found a genuinely STALE FACT here — I had recorded 'OpenAI pushed to 2027' when OpenAI had in fact filed confidentially on June 8 with a Sept-Q4 window — but the prior barely moves, because the fact was not load-bearing in the way I had written it: what protects this position is the ARITHMETIC GAP ($1T target vs a $2.0-2.1T bar), not the absence of a rival. Worth remembering that a stale fact and a wrong conclusion are different things; correcting the first does not always move the number, and a sweep that discriminates is more trustworthy than one that always fires. The resting maker sell at 0.96 sits ABOVE fair, which makes it a clean premium-exit option rather than a wash.
